module_summary: UART receiver: a prescale down-counter times oversampled bit periods, a bit counter sequences start/data/stop, a shift register deserializes rxd into an AXI-stream output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received byte presented on AXI-stream output, copied from m_axis_tdata_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-stream valid; set when stop bit received, cleared on accept.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready; with tvalid clears the output valid register.

anchors.name: rxd
anchors.why: Serial UART input line, sampled into rxd_reg each cycle.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Shift register assembling received data bits LSB first before output.

anchors.name: bit_cnt
anchors.why: Counts remaining start/data/stop bits; sequences reception phases.

anchors.name: prescale_reg
anchors.why: Baud prescale down-counter timing each bit sample point.

anchors.name: prescale
anchors.why: Configured baud divisor reloading the prescale counter.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Level busy indication while a frame is being received.

anchors.name: overrun_error
anchors.why: Pulses when new byte arrives while previous output still valid.

anchors.name: frame_error
anchors.why: Pulses when stop bit sampled low.

groups.name: AXI-stream output
groups.description: Output data/valid registers with ready-based valid clear.

groups.name: Deserializer
groups.description: Synchronizes rxd and shifts sampled bits into data_reg.

groups.name: Bit timing
groups.description: Prescale timer and bit counter sequencing start, data and stop bits.

groups.name: Status flags
groups.description: Busy level and overrun/frame error pulses.
